observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for MongoDB OperationFailure code 125, which indicates a cluster not found in an Atlas Data Federation or Online Archive project.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could help PostHog warehouse ingestion avoid infinite retry loops when a federated database's cluster reference becomes stale. By classifying this error as non-retryable, PostHog can stop repeatedly fetching the same stale configuration and instead fail gracefully, prompting the user to update their data source configuration.
